info.name: Rapid Capsule API Collection v5.0
info.description:
Complete API documentation for Rapid Capsule Telemedicine Platform.

**Patient API**: https://api.rapidcapsule.com/api
**Specialist API**: https://api.rapidcapsule.com/api
**Admin API**: https://admin.rapidcapsule.com/admin-api

Total Endpoints: 600+

Includes: Biometric/WebAuthn Authentication, Session Management, Notifications, RxGPT AI Prescription Analysis, Linked Records, Admin RxGPT Management, Trial Access, Health Integrations, Clinical Note Templates, Pharmacy Inventory, Accounting Wallet, WhatsApp Queue, Specialist Pharmacy Portal, Webhooks, Eka AI Companion

Created by Bassey Eyo (eyobassey@gmail.com) - Founder & CTO

item.name: RxGPT (AI Prescription Analysis)
